standby_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before entering standby (0=disabled, max 7200 with encoding)

deep_sleep.description: Deep sleep level (0=off, >0 enables); not widely supported

multi_sector_io.description: Number of sectors per multi-sector I/O command (1–16)

devices.description: List of device-specific configurations, each with 'device' (e.g., '/dev/sda') and optional overrides

global_power_during_resume.description: If true, reapply power settings on system resume (used with pm-utils)
